tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Germanic adal, 'noble', via the French Alis. Its root is Germanic adal. A medieval Christian name; borne by Saint Alice. Alice is a Germanic name meaning “Noble; of noble kind”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
